h:
Magic WAN Image v2 是 Wan 2.2-T2V-14B 文本到视频模型的混合和微调版本，旨在让 Wan 2.2 用户更轻松地生成图像，类似于 Flux 模型的使用方式。 Wan 2.2模型擅长生成逼真的图像，并支持广泛的艺术风格。 （原始模型链接 -https://civitai.com/models/1927692?modelVersionId=2399857）因为它最初是为视频生成而设计的，所以它的原始图像生成功能稍弱，但这个版本改善了这种平衡。该模型旨在结合现实主义和风格，同时添加更多细节，旨在实现与 Flux.1-Dev 模型相媲美的创造力和表现力。它是通过混合不同重量级别的 Wan2.2-T2V-14B 模型的高噪声和低噪声组件，然后进行轻微微调而创建的。其结果是高度逼真的皮肤纹理和超高分辨率输出，使其非常适合肖像和现实世界场景。它可产生丰富的细节，并支持使用 TTP 技术直接升级至 8 兆像素图像。该模型可以使用任何现有的 WAN 2.1 或 WAN 2.2 LORA（SFW 和 NSFW）、编码器（剪辑文件）和 VAE。我之前开发过可以执行文本到图像、图像到图像、图像的工作流程 通过欺骗 WAN 视频模型生成图像输出来进行修复和图像修复，该模型经过专门训练，可以更精确地完成这些任务（这可以很好地处理 WAN 2.2 高和低 LORA 以及常规 WAN 2.1 LORA）。

这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的文本到图像工作流程，它将与具有多个 LORA 的单个 Magic WAN Image v2 GGUF 模型一起使用（此工作流程确实需要 ComfyUI 的 LORA Manager 插件才能运行。最好安装 ComfyUI 管理器和 LORA Manager 插件，以帮助您轻松下载和管理检查点、LORA 和其他资源。这两个不仅对此工作流程有帮助，而且在任何其他情况下都会为您提供很大帮助）。您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载所需的文件（详情如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、QWEN、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、Z-Image Turbo 和 通量。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 Magic WAN Image v2 GGUF 模型，然后加载

#2.从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃3。然后输入你的正面和负面提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

*** 即使您不使用任何单个 LORA，此工作流程也将起作用

o.en:
Magic WAN Image v2 is a mixed and fine-tuned version of the Wan 2.2-T2V-14B text-to-video model, adapted to make image generation easier for Wan 2.2 users, similar to how the Flux model is used. The Wan 2.2 model is strong at producing realistic images and supports a wide range of artistic styles. ( Original Model Link -https://civitai.com/models/1927692?modelVersionId=2399857) Because it was originally designed for video generation, its raw image generation is slightly less powerful, but this version improves that balance. This model is designed to combine realism and style while adding more detail, aiming for creativity and expressiveness comparable to the Flux.1-Dev model. It was created by blending the high-noise and low-noise components of the Wan2.2-T2V-14B model at different weight levels, followed by light fine-tuning. The result is highly realistic skin textures and ultra-high-resolution output, making it well suited for portraits and real-world scenes. It produces rich detail and supports direct upscaling to 8-megapixel images using TTP technology. This is a model that can use any existing WAN 2.1 or WAN 2.2 LORAs (SFW & NSFW), Encoders (clip file) and VAE. I have previously developed Workflows that can do Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, Image Inpainting and Image Outpainting by tricking WAN video models to generate image outputs, this model has been dedicatedly trained to acheive those tasks with more precision (this can handle both WAN 2.2 High & Low LORAs as well as regular WAN 2.1 LORAs very well).

This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Text-to-Image workflow that will work with a single Magic WAN Image v2 GGUF model with multiple LORAs (This workflow does require ComfyUI's LORA Manager plugin to function. It is a good idea to install both ComfyUI manager and LORA Manager plugin to help you easily download and manage Checkpoints, LORAs and other resources. Not only these two are helpful for this workflow but they will help you a lot in any other cases). You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, QWEN, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, Z-Image Turbo and Flux.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Magic WAN Image v2 GGUF model first and then load

#2. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#3. then input your positive and negative prompts.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

*** This workflow will also function even if you don't use any single LORA
